## Executive Overview
WPCarePoint is a British digital consultancy and engineering practice partnering with UK organisations since 2019 (900+ programmes delivered, 4.9/5 client rating). We engineer bespoke websites, WooCommerce retail platforms, brand identity systems, technical SEO, Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), AI Search Optimisation for ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude, and UK GDPR–compliant AI business process automation.

All engagements follow four non-negotiable standards:
1. UK/EEA Data Sovereignty (UK GDPR & ICO PECR compliance; zero model training on client enquiry data).
2. WCAG 2.2 Level AA Accessibility & GDS-aligned semantic HTML.
3. OWASP Top-10 Hardening & strictly server-side API secrets.
4. Sub-1.2s Mobile Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) performance budgets and 100% client IP ownership.

## Frequently Asked Questions (UK Governance & Operations)
1. **Do you handle both custom web builds and AI / GEO growth under one team?** Yes—we architect websites, e-commerce platforms, APIs, SEO, GEO, AI Search Optimisation (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude), and business process automation in-house.
2. **Do you support UK hosting providers and Nominet .co.uk domains?** Yes—20i, Krystal, SiteGround UK, Namecheap, Vercel, AWS London, and Cloudflare alongside Nominet .co.uk and .uk domains.
3. **Are your websites, AI integrations, and backups UK GDPR compliant?** Yes—UK GDPR & PECR consent architecture, encrypted UK/EEA backup residency, and zero-training commercial AI tiers.
4. **Are care plans billed in GBP and do you require long-term contracts?** All Managed Care Retainers are invoiced transparently in GBP (£) on rolling monthly terms with zero lock-in, or optional annual billing with 17% savings.
5. **Can you rebuild a lost .co.uk website without losing Google UK rankings?** Yes—we audit Google Search Console and archival snapshots, preserve matching URL slugs, deploy server-level 301 redirects, and configure Schema.org plus `/llms.txt`.
